text_block_list.text:
A little while after New Year's, I bumped 
into Espoir City at the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ah...

Espoir City remained silent. She was low 
on energy, but didn't seem to be in a bad 
mood.
choice_data_list:
(Since we're here, I should try to find 
something to talk about...!)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!
choice_data_list: （せっかくだから、何か話題を……！）
choice_data_list_en: (Since we're here, I should bring up a topic...!)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!
(Grrr~)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! Bursting with savory juices with 
every bite, an exquisite dish made with a 
whole, piping-hot carrot!
(Grrr~~~)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: H-Huh!? That's really not—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Guh... Wait! I said stop! Hey—
choice_data_list: 君は頑張れって応援して！
貴方は頑張れって応援して！
choice_data_list_en: Just cheer me on and tell me to do my best!
Cheer them on and tell them to give it their all!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wait, they're already linin' up!? 
Aaaagh~~~~...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Knock yourself out!

Spurred on by Espoir City's cheers, I 
bravely spun the raffle wheel's lever!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wait, that's way better than first prize!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Jeez. Well...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text:
"Ehhh!? Did someone finally hit the grand 
prize!?" "Look, it was that person over 
there! Amazing!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Not half bad, huh.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer. Hold the travel voucher 
in your right hand. Then, give me a fist 
pump with the right.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wow... That's amazing..." "So that's 
what overwhelming luck looks like...!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Keep appealing to the crowd 
like that! Higher! And then—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: So, stay just like me. Okay?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Pointless.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I'm givin' that travel voucher to you, 
dammit! Use it whenever the hell you 
want!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: See ya!

And with that, Espoir City walked away, 
leaving behind only the travel vouchers.

"...I'll put this ticket away for a while. 
Now doesn't seem like the right time to 
use it."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Not bad.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Don't get cocky. Anyway...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
We're outside, though. How are we supposed 
to eat this?
(Sizzle! Sizzle-fry!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you make a bunch of extra stuff 
too?
choice_data_list: I'll make sure you leave completely full!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Her annoying switch just flipped...
choice_data_list: お腹いっぱいにしてみせるよ！
choice_data_list_en: I'll make sure you eat your fill!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I refuse.
choice_data_list_en: Have a seat and wait, okay?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Come on, make more room over there!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Look at all this laundry piled up 
already. Geez.
Espoir City barged right into the kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, your cooking is damn good. And 
you're not bad either.

And then, as if suddenly letting her guard 
down, she smiled.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haha, there's a whole lot of this...!
choice_data_list: I hope this meets your satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wasn't first prize, after all.
choice_data_list: ご満足いただけたでしょうか
choice_data_list_en: Did everything meet with your satisfaction?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
If we're gonna eat it, let's make it 
delicious. I'll take it over to Tap's 
place.
choice_data_list: Tap... You mean Tap Dance City?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Leave it to him and—
choice_data_list: タップって……タップダンスシチー？
choice_data_list_en: Tap... you mean Tap Dance City?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: It's party timeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks a lot! Espo! Trainer! I'm gonna 
throw us the best BBQ party tonight!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, grill it up! Eat up, eat up! I owed 
Tap one anyway.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hm? A debt?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...About you joining me for morning 
training before.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's from quite a while ago, isn't 
it! Espo really has integrity~

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: In... inte...?
choice_data_list: I guess that shows how dutiful you are.

text_block_list.name: Espo & Tap
text_block_list.text: H-Huuuh~~!? That's right!
choice_data_list: 義理堅いってことかな
choice_data_list_en: I guess that means they have a strong sense of duty.

text_block_list.text:
A night of feasting begins with former 
training partners. Laughter of Umamusume 
echoed through the night sky.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Well, getting all fired up like that just 
for a single carrot... Heh.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: It's barely even a snack!
choice_data_list: Isn't that plenty for a snack?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Once I start eatin', I just get even 
hungrier!"
choice_data_list: おやつになるなら十分じゃ？
choice_data_list_en: If it works as a snack, isn't that good enough?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, take me to a family restaurant or 
something. Let's go eat.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

On the way to the family restaurant, the 
whole carrot disappeared into her belly in 
the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Don't go getting more depressed than I 
am! Idiot!"

In the end, all that effort amounted to 
nothing at all...
